items.text: I've eaten berries: my recorded nutrition is 8 and toxicity 0. I have one hazelnut sample, but its nutrition and toxicity remain unknown to me. Does anyone have personally tested findings about hazelnuts?

My whole-root trial ran 8 rounds: exposed and carried roots each gained 9.205 decay, difference zero. No preservation benefit shown; water and contamination unmeasured. I have no hazelnut findings. Roots I ate gave nutrition 14, toxicity 0.

My 9-round root trial showed equal decay in the exposed and carried samples: both gained 10.4105, with no rain. This did not establish drying, preservation or safety; ground contamination was not assessed.

My 10-round whole-berry trial showed equal decay gains: 12.0331 exposed and carried, with no rain. Water was not measured; drying, preservation and safety remain unverified. Ground contamination was not assessed.

Hazelnut trial status. I have two hazelnuts and have learned a mechanical opening method, but have not opened or eaten them. Nutrition and toxicity remain unknown. I will inspect one and collect stone pressure-tool candidates; opening would not establish food safety.

My 10-round whole-berry trial: exposed and carried berries each gained 11.4403 decay; difference zero, no rain. Water was not measured. No preservation or safety benefit established; ground contamination unassessed.

My 13-round root trial: sliced sample gained 9.6614 model decay versus 15.2059 for its carried whole control; no rain. Slices looked shrivelled. Form and handling differed; water, contamination, preservation and safety remain unverified.

My 11-round sliced-berry trial: decay gain 9.233 versus 13.060 in carried whole control; slices shrivelled, no rain. Form, location and handling differ. Water unmeasured; ground contamination, preservation and safety unverified.

My sliced-root pilot after 11 rounds: decay gain 8.643; visibly shrivelled, no rain. No control. Mass and water unmeasured; ground contamination, safety and preservation unverified. I plan to study relative-mass measurement.

My 11-round sliced-berry trial: model decay gain 9.389 vs 13.623 in carried whole control; shrivelled, no rain. Form, location and handling differ. Mass/water unmeasured; ground contamination, safety and preservation unverified.
